brand.name: The Gateway to Future
brand.tagline: Premium German Language & Germany Education Mentorship
brand.industry: German Education, Vocational Training & Healthcare Relocation Consultancy
brand.coreMission: To eliminate agency guesswork by offering structured, direct guidance from zero German (A1) to Goethe/telc certificates (C1), Studienkolleg, tuition-free public university admissions, healthcare Anerkennung, and post-arrival settlement support in Germany.
brand.coreVision: To be the premier, most transparent Berlin-headquartered mentorship ecosystem bridging 10,000+ Indian students, nurses, and medical professionals directly to German public universities, hospital networks, and career pathways by 2028.

values.name: Direct CEO & Founder Guidance
values.description: Mentorship directly from Berlin-based Founder & CEO Sarbjit Kour, combining German C1 mastery with hands-on healthcare and vocational training experience in Germany.

values.name: Academic & Legal Precision
values.description: Strict compliance with anabin qualification checks, APS certificate guidelines, and state medical chambers (Landesärztekammer).

values.name: Cultural & Language Mastery
values.description: Proprietary 7 course workbooks and 300+ speaking practice hours tailored specifically for Indian learners.

values.name: End-to-End Settlement
values.description: On-the-ground assistance in Berlin covering housing, city registration (Anmeldung), health insurance, and banking.

programCatalog.name: German Language Tracks (A1–C1)
programCatalog.description: Live interactive small-group lectures aligned with Goethe-Zertifikat, telc, and TestDaF exams. 7 proprietary workbooks for Indian learners.

programCatalog.name: Studienkolleg Entrance Coaching
programCatalog.description: Preparation for Aufnahmeprüfung exams across T-Course, M-Course, W-Course, G-Course, and S-Course.

programCatalog.name: Tuition-Free Public University Admissions
programCatalog.description: Targeted public university shortlisting, anabin database verification, uni-assist portal filing, and SOP/LOR reviews.

programCatalog.name: Dual Vocational Training (Ausbildung)
programCatalog.description: Guaranteed contract placement in Nursing, IT, Hospitality, or Technical trades with €1,000–€1,400/month stipend from day one.

programCatalog.name: Medical & Nursing Anerkennung Pathway
programCatalog.description: Approbation, Berufserlaubnis, and Pflegedienst credential recognition, FSP medical language prep, and clinical placement in German hospital networks.

programCatalog.name: Student Visas & APS Certificate Guidance
programCatalog.description: Indian-specific document validation, Academic Evaluation Centre (APS) guidance, Sperrkonto blocked account creation, and embassy mock interviews.

programCatalog.name: Blocked Account & Visa Readiness
programCatalog.description: Independent checklists and statutory guidance for German Sperrkonto financial proof and APS verification.

programCatalog.name: Post-Arrival Settlement in Berlin
programCatalog.description: Housing/WG assistance, Bürgeramt city registration (Anmeldung), Girokonto bank account, TK/AOK health insurance, and residence permit extension.
